query: Research current Google Gemini AI Pro and AI Ultra coding-plan Value Multiples for ValueRank, including the 5x and 20x Ultra quota tiers.

assumptions.text: Antigravity is the current coding surface after Google's June 2026 consumer-plan transition.
Google's relative quota tiers can be used to scale a community-modeled Pro baseline.
Plan Costs divides API-priced task cost by Value Multiple and does not add the monthly sticker price per task.
